text:
Sam: Planning a precision slowspin for llmroute v4 tomorrow 07:15 UTC. Strategy: tiny initial cohort in prod-us, slow steady increases, optional version-pin toggle. Will use ff `llmroute_v4` and create an ephemeral cohort `slowspin-1`. Keep noise floor monitoring and token-cost snapshot.

Priya: +1. Suggest ramp: 0.5% -> 2% (hold 20m) -> 10% -> 30% -> 100%. At each holdpoint deploy-bot should post: latency p50/p95, 1m error rate, token cost per 1k, and a small sample of top-5 prompts for quality review.

Dmitri: Add the following safety knobs: automatic pin if p95 latency increases by >120ms OR error rate >0.8% OR infra CPU on host > 85%. Also include a manual fast-rollback command that pins routing and disables cohort in one step.

Anya: I'll prepare a short release-note blurb and include the model diff summary. Also adding a line about expected changed ranking behavior so SRE and CS are not surprised.

Sam: Deploy commands for ops:```
# create cohort and seed to 0.5%
rb ff create-cohort llmroute_v4 slowspin-1 --region prod-us
rb ff set llmroute_v4 --cohort slowspin-1 --weight 0.5
# to pin back to stable (v3) quickly
rb ff set llmroute_v4 --cohort global --weight 0
rb route set default --model llmroute-v3
```

Priya: Can deploy-bot also attach a preflight cost snapshot and tail-latency baseline? We'll compare delta at each holdpoint.

deploy-bot: Preflight snapshot captured: p50=48ms p95=120ms token_cost_per_1k= $0.38. Canary cohort slowspin-1 created (id: ss-7b2). Rollout scheduled at 2025-08-03T07:15:00Z. Will post metrics at each holdpoint and can run automatic pin if thresholds exceeded.

Dmitri: Good. For the automatic-pin path, make sure we label the incident with `rollback:automated` and notify #eng-oncall. Also, before pinning automatically, deploy-bot should attempt a conservative fallback: reduce cohort to 1% for 5m and re-evaluate once. If still bad, do full pin.

Anya: Release note draft: "llmroute v4: improved reranking with contextual normalization. Rolling out slowly starting with prod-us. Expect subtle rank shifts for edge queries; contact CS if major regressions observed." Link to docs: https://redwood.example.com/releases/llmroute-v4/docs.

Sam: Final rollout rule: at each holdpoint run 15m soak. If any of (p95+120ms, error_rate>0.8%, cost_per_1k increases by >30%) -> first step: reduce cohort to 1% and notify oncall; if after 5m the metric hasn't recovered -> pin to v3 and drain cohort. Otherwise continue ramp after ops ack.

Priya: I'll be on watch for initial window. Dmitri, Anya please stand by for the 2% holdpoint.

Dmitri: Standing by.

Anya: Standing by and will post release-note final once rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
